factual_claims.source_evidence: Balance Sheet (page 43) and Note 15 confirm interest-bearing debt of SEK 1,382,613k (2025) vs SEK 1,483,061k (2024). Net interest-bearing debt is SEK 1,337,465k with cash balances of SEK 45,149k.

factual_claims.claim: Management notes that successful execution of future business plans remains dependent on securing new financing during 2026, creating significant uncertainty if alternative funding options fail.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Note 2 (page 53) under 'Going Concern Assumption' states uncertainty exists if new financing cannot be secured in 2026.

numerical_claims.claim: Total revenue for the group increased by 9.8 percent to SEK 239,655 thousand in 2025 compared to SEK 218,264 thousand in 2024.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT

numerical_claims.claim: Net revenue from electricity sales rose by 9.9 percent to SEK 203,179 thousand from SEK 184,795 thousand, representing 85 percent of total revenue.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_value: SEK 203,179 thousand (2025) vs SEK 184,795 thousand (2024), 85% of total revenue

numerical_claims.claim: Other operating income, primarily consisting of government and regional subsidies, amounted to SEK 36,476 thousand compared to SEK 33,469 thousand.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT

numerical_claims.claim: Gross profit improved to SEK 195,829 thousand from SEK 179,219 thousand, maintaining a stable gross margin of 82 percent.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_value: SEK 195,829 thousand (2025) vs SEK 179,219 thousand (2024), 82% gross margin

numerical_claims.claim: Earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization rose to SEK 163,733 thousand from SEK 145,760 thousand, yielding an EBITDA margin of 68 percent.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_value: SEK 163,733 thousand (2025) vs SEK 145,760 thousand (2024), 68% EBITDA margin

numerical_claims.claim: Operating profit increased by 21.1 percent to SEK 73,478 thousand from SEK 60,677 thousand, with the operating margin improving to 31 percent from 28 percent.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_value: SEK 73,478 thousand (2025) vs SEK 60,677 thousand (2024), 31% operating margin vs 28%
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Board of Directors' Report (page 39) and Definitions (page 70)

numerical_claims.claim: Profit after tax improved significantly to SEK -7,206 thousand, compared to SEK -32,944 thousand in the preceding year, impacted by a non-cash currency effect of SEK -3,843 thousand and a one-off cost of SEK 3.5 million.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_value: SEK -7,206 thousand (2025) vs SEK -32,944 thousand (2024), SEK -3,843 thousand currency effect, SEK 3.5 million one-off cost
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Income Statement (page 42) and Board of Directors' Report (page 39)

numerical_claims.claim: Earnings per share after dilution were SEK -0.13, improving from SEK -0.58 in 2024.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT

numerical_claims.claim: Total installed revenue-generating capacity reached 395.8 MW at year-end, up from 340.1 MW, representing an expansion of 55.7 MW across 216 installations and 197 customers.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_value: 395.8 MW (2025) vs 340.1 MW (2024), 55.7 MW increase, 216 installations, 197 customers
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Board of Directors' Report (page 39) and Operations section (page 15)

numerical_claims.claim: Produced electricity increased to 327.8 million kWh, reducing carbon dioxide-related emissions by approximately 161,000 tonnes compared to 124,000 tonnes in 2024.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_value: 327.8 million kWh (2025) vs unspecified 2024 figure, 161,000 tonnes CO2 reduction vs 124,000 tonnes
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Board of Directors' Report (page 39) and Sustainability section (page 22)

numerical_claims.claim: The company signed 17 new contracts representing 41.7 MW of installed capacity, leaving 16.4 MW in signed orders at the end of the year.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_value: 17 contracts for 41.7 MW, 16.4 MW in signed orders

numerical_claims.claim: Gigasun implemented major strategic measures, including agreements with Agricultural Bank Financial Leasing Co., Ltd to refinance approximately SEK 1,242 million in total, extending loan amortization periods to 10 years at a 3.60 percent interest rate to lower financing costs and improve cash flow.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_value: SEK 1,242 million refinancing, 10-year amortization, 3.60% interest rate
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Board of Directors' Report (page 39) and Note 18

numerical_claims.claim: The remaining SOLT4 bond was extended to November 8, 2026, with an interest rate of 14.25 percent.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_value: SOLT4 bond extended to November 8, 2026 at 14.25% interest
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Note 16 (page 64) and Board of Directors' Report (page 39)

numerical_claims.claim: Market conditions were affected by regional electricity tariff adjustments in mid-2025 that reduced realized prices by about 8 percent in the second half of the year.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_value: 8% price reduction in H2 2025 due to tariff adjustments

numerical_claims.claim: Total assets stood at SEK 2,296,782 thousand at year-end, down from SEK 2,528,093 thousand, while equity totaled SEK 488,201 thousand, resulting in an equity ratio of 21 percent compared to 23 percent in 2024.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_value: SEK 2,296,782 thousand assets (2025), SEK 2,528,093 thousand (2024), SEK 488,201 thousand equity (2025), 21% equity ratio vs 23% (2024)
